name: Joplin
description: Joplin maps supported platform architectures to metadata filenames, derives a generic feed URL from release data, and delegates checking/retrieval to electron-updater; the reviewed service does not show SHA512 or Authenticode publisher matching.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot; not historical release re-verification.
External updater-library behavior and released artifact signing/notarization remain outside the cited source unless directly shown.
